description: This file implements a gRPC server for controlling OpenWRT devices via Luci RPC, including authentication handling, IP address retrieval from logs, and server setup.

classes.name: OpenwrtControlServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the gRPC service for OpenWRT control, handling RPC requests, authentication, and IP address retrieval.

methods.name: LuciRpc
methods.description: Handles Luci RPC requests, manages authentication, and processes responses.

methods.name: OpenwrtIpaddr
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of the OpenWRT device from launcher logs.

methods.name: UpdateLuciRpcAuthKey
methods.description: Updates the authentication key for Luci RPC by making an HTTP login request.

methods.name: RequestLuciRpc
methods.description: Sends a Luci RPC request with specified method and parameters.

methods.name: FindIpaddrLauncherLog
methods.description: Parses launcher log to find the WAN IP address.

methods.name: ToVector
methods.description: Converts a protobuf repeated field to a std::vector.

methods.name: LuciRpcAddress
methods.description: Constructs the URL for Luci RPC, optionally with authentication.

methods.name: LuciRpcData
methods.description: Creates JSON data for Luci RPC requests.
